description:
Convergent empirical signal from ariadne PLINY (2026-05-06): a NEW worktree (silly-gagarin-7e0342) was just spawned by Claude Code for Batch H work, and the harness re-introduced the broken pattern (extensions.worktreeConfig=true in main .git/config + per-worktree config.worktree). Confirms the regression reproduces on every fresh worktree creation, not just on installs.

Brief upstream-source probe:
- Claude Code CLI lives at ~/AppData/Roaming/npm/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli.js (single ~19k-line minified bundle).
- Patchable in principle but npm auto-update would wipe any patch.
- MSIX desktop install is sandboxed.
- No user-level hook event for worktree creation.

Conclusion: upstream-unpatchable from our position. Pivot to substrate-reflex pattern.

## Scope

Add an activation-reflex pattern to substrate so that any seat (PLINY, POLYBIUS, any CAPTAIN) hitting the worktreeconfig error on bw prime applies the fix mechanically and proceeds, without surfacing to PRINCIPAL.

1. **operating-disciplines.md §9.** Append an "Activation reflex" sentence to the existing Windows-worktree paragraph: when bw prime errors with this signature on session start, the fix is mechanical and the cause is upstream — apply the three commands and proceed; don't surface.

2. **MAJOR_PLINY.md §9 (activation checklist) step 3.** Add an inline sub-bullet: if `bw prime` errors with the worktreeconfig signature, run the three commands against the parent repo's .git/config inline (don't context-switch to operating-disciplines.md to look them up), re-run bw prime, continue.

Use the same camelCase + ordering as the existing operating-disciplines.md §9 paragraph (extensions.worktreeConfig camelCase; unset, format=0, longpaths=true order).

## Sequencing

Lands on the same branch as stoa--7kg phase 2 (claude/agitated-chaum-85a85e), via the same PR (denson/the-stoa#1). Add a third commit; CATO eyeball; close.

## Out of scope

- Filing an upstream issue against anthropics/claude-code (the existing #45645 is already filed; user can decide whether to comment).
- Monkey-patching cli.js.
- Migrating to a different bw version (separate question per stoa--7kg).
title: Activation reflex: auto-clean worktreeconfig regression on bw prime failure
